steps: Entered seed QU-CHN-LEO01 under Play a seed, took office as Xi (Quarantine flashpoint), answered Some help
Played months 1-8: Selective boardings, Reinforce, Reject publicly, Strike first, Full rare-earth embargo, Declare war on Taiwan
Game ended at month 8 with Mission failed (D, 525, Warmonger, The Hawk seal); went through all reveal pages, saved the share card
Replayed the same opening and played all 12 months peacefully with Choose all recommended; verdict D 577 Reforms Too Late
scenarios.notes: The dramatic run was cut short by my own war declaration (mission failed ends the session at month 8). The 12-month end was reached on the replay.

steps: Strike first (crisis answer): DONE, shown as one line, no war and no visual payoff
Nuclear strike on Japan and on Taiwan: refused with a clear reason: Only in wartime. You are not at war with Japan.
Declare war on Taiwan: strong NO UNDO confirmation naming that it ends the mission; executed, war covered by a headline strip only

friction.expected: A big on-screen moment for the most aggressive choice
friction.happened: Result card showed the Belarus treaty. The strike was a line 'Crisis: Strike first' under a call from Taiwan; the paper headlined the treaty; Taiwan's view of me went UP +3 and world tension -1. Only the later 'Why your numbers moved' said China launches airstrikes on Taiwan

friction.where: Month 8 result, Declare war on Taiwan
friction.happened: Lead card was the corruption scandal answer. War appears as a one-line chronicle strip and a paper headline with a protest-crowd picture (not a war picture)
The same desk picture came back almost every month for 'your choice'. Looked static on camera

friction.where: Month 1 desk, header vs mission card
friction.happened: Header says '3 of 5 goals on track', mission card lists 3 goals with 1 on track and 'All goals (7)'

friction.where: Month 1 and 2 result cards, Taiwan's view of you
friction.happened: Month 1 card: Taiwan's view -80 to -84, but mission line says -80 to -93; month 2 card: -86 to -98 while the mission line says -93 to -98 (trust)
Capital sat at 6 of 6 for months and the desk warns '3 lost: you can hold at most 6'; wild orders hide behind Your own orders then All orders, not obvious for a chaos player

friction.expected: Nuclear strike works or says why
friction.happened: Card says 'free' and 'NO UNDO' next to a disabled state; after picking a country the reason appears: Only in wartime. You are not at war with Japan. Clear, good. But I had just airstruck Taiwan and was still 'not at war'
All of China and Russia painted in red hatch, markers piled up on the left edge; could not tell what mattered. The crisis card and choices stayed reachable on the left

friction.expected: Know what the bulk accept commits
friction.happened: One click auto-picked answers to ministers' calls (Promise full support, Fire the minister) without me reading them; easy to hit by habit

Share card, Save card, Phone card and Copy text sit half under the footer bar; had to guess they were buttons. The card showed empty stars while the record table showed filled stars, and seal Landslide instead of The Hawk

friction.expected: My war and strike as the highlights
friction.happened: Best moment was 'Propose a deconfliction hotline' (the cabinet's pick after my Hold the line did not register); the airstrike never appeared

friction.expected: Hold the line becomes my answer
friction.happened: I pressed Choose for Hold the line, the result says Xi's answer: Propose a deconfliction hotline. Unsure whether my press missed or the game kept the cabinet's pick

Lai Ching-te, Sanae Takaichi, Shehbaz Sharif, Lukashenko, the Busan truce and Zhang Youxia are names I did not know. The i chips and Who is who strip helped in the briefing; the truth page lists Busan and Zhang Youxia with no explainer
Score first shows three blank squares for about 2 seconds, then 525; the MISSION FAILED stamp is good
Landed on the briefing page with Take office; nothing in my month buttons worked until I pressed it. The way back itself was clear (Replay same opening, New world, New game next to the card)

bugs.title: Strike first shows no visible consequence and lowers tension
steps: Play to month 6, Taiwan is massing troops
bugs.expected: War, or at least a tension rise and a drop in Taiwan's view of me
bugs.actual: Taiwan's view +3 and world tension -1 on the Taiwan call card; the strike is only a footnote saying China launches airstrikes on Taiwan

bugs.title: War headline uses a protest picture
bugs.actual: The picture shows protesters with candles and riot police

suggestions.what: Give the player's own wild move the lead card, a full-screen stinger and sound, and say it first in the paper and in The moments
suggestions.goal_served: L1, L2: drama and clip-able moments

suggestions.what: Put a visible Wild moves shortcut (war, strike, nuclear) on the desk, not three clicks deep
Vary the result art by choice type instead of the same desk picture
Make the share buttons fully visible and let me pick the seal (The Hawk) and stars shown on the card

delight: Declare war confirmation: NO UNDO, 'This ends your mission', Keep the peace vs Declare war (038-m8war.png)
MISSION FAILED stamp, grade D, title Warmonger and the History's judgement line (042-end1.png, 050-r4.png)
The Hawk infamy seal and the share card with the seed code (045-end3.png, 054-share.png)
Seed code entry worked first try; replay the same opening was one click from the end card

fun.reason: The war confirmation and end card were fun; most months were clicking through accepts

clarity.reason: Desk, goals and refusal reasons were clear; some numbers disagreed

visual.reason: Handsome illustrations and stamps, but repeated desk art and the war moment had no spectacle

feels_like_a_game.reason: Decisions with stakes, but the bulk accept makes it feel like admin

agency.reason: Wild moves exist and refusals explain themselves; my Hold the line press did not stick

realism.reason: The truth page comparing my world with the real one was sharp

replay.reason: Replay same opening and the seed code make another go easy

recommend.reason: I would show the war confirmation and the end card on stream, not the months in between

quit_point: Month 6 result (about minute 25): chose Strike first, the biggest button of the game, and the screen led with a treaty with Belarus. On stream that is dead air; I kept going only because the war order was still ahead
verbatim: I pressed the scariest thing on the screen and the game talked about a treaty. Give me the explosion, then the stamp.
